newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle thin at $105/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle thin at $105/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold near midday Thursday at $104.00 to $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light volume, unchanged from Wednesday, market sources said.
About 1,000 head sold, which brought the week to date estimate near 94,000.
"Trade was very light because most of this week's showlist has already been sold," one market source said.
Cattle owners next week were seen pricing cattle higher, but the actual level was unclear, the sources said.
